basis: Acute myeloid leukemia, colonic polyposis and colon cancer define the syndrome; unspecified genitourinary abnormalities do not establish another axis.
Obstruction of the lacrimal drainage system.
Hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia and polycystic kidney disease are both defining features.
Glycosylation defect with cardiomyopathy (80-99%) and ichthyosis (3/4); seizures and developmental delay occur in 30-79%. Elevated transaminases alone do not establish liver damage.
Carcinoma confined to the tracheal mucosal epithelium.
Inherited LDL cholesterol metabolic disorder; atherosclerotic disease is a separate downstream disease. Corneal arcus does not impair ocular function.
Valvular disease, skeletal fusions and hearing impairment define the syndrome. Reflux is separately diagnosed; singleton gastroparesis does not establish population frequency.
Mitochondrial respiratory-chain metabolic defect; neurologic dysfunction is common (>30%) across symptomatic presentations. Muscle, cardiac and ocular involvement vary by subtype.
Congenital partial or complete absence of the radius, usually with associated hand skeletal abnormalities.
Axonal sensorimotor neuropathy; unilateral renal agenesis reported in 21/21. Infection is a trigger; an infectious or immune-mediated mechanism is not established.
Intestinal water absorption is impaired by poorly absorbed luminal solutes; electrolyte loss does not establish a separate metabolic disorder.
MYT1L-related intellectual and developmental impairment. Obesity is separately diagnosed; singleton strabismus does not establish common ocular damage.
Malignant tumor arising in the orbit; skeletal muscle differentiation describes its histology.
Testicular steroidogenesis defect; urethral malformation includes hypospadias (80-99%) and urogenital sinus anomaly (30-79%). Other genital features are reproductive.
Glycosylation defect with developmental encephalopathy and coagulopathy; cataract occurs in 30-79%, with defining coloboma. Joint hypermobility (2/3) omitted by cap.
Gastric mucosal inflammation with subepithelial collagen deposition. Associated iron deficiency is separately diagnosed; autoimmunity is not established by inflammation alone.
Metabolic defect with neutropenia and impaired neutrophil function; hepatic glycogen storage and dysfunction in most (>80%). Bowel inflammation and bone disease omitted by cap.
Umbrella for inborn amino-acid metabolic disorders; neurologic damage in a particular subtype does not establish involvement across the group.
Poorly specified faciodigitogenital syndrome; digital skeletal abnormalities support musculoskeletal involvement. No definition or phenotype data establish additional axes.
Early-onset epilepsy, sometimes with developmental delay. Patent foramen ovale is reported in only 1/4 and does not establish common cardiac damage.
Vascular tumors cause platelet trapping and consumptive coagulopathy. Petechiae and purpura do not establish independent skin disease; hepatic tumors occur in only 5-29%.
Sclerodermatous skin, fat loss and osteolysis; intrinsic progressive arterial disease affects most, hearing loss 80-99%. Endocrine abnormalities omitted by cap.
Multicystic mesothelial tumor of the peritoneal lining; pelvic location does not establish reproductive-organ involvement.
Malignant neoplasm involving the cauda equina nerve roots.
Benign neoplasm of a reproductive organ; this umbrella does not establish hormonal dysfunction or an endocrine-cell origin.
